Bhopal Residents Feed Donkeys Gulab Jamun in Unusual Rain Ritual

Residents of Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, have engaged in an unusual ritual of feeding donkeys gulab jamun. This act is part of a traditional practice believed to invoke rainfall. The ritual comes as 35 districts in the state have experienced below-normal rainfall, highlighting concerns about the monsoon's progress.
